feeds.title: Julie Naturally Blog
feeds.description: Julie Naturally aims to equip Christian homeschooling families with the tools and resources needed to embrace a natural lifestyle even if they live in a city or apartment. A natural Christian lifestyle encompasses four main areas: homeschooling, holy living, holistic health, and homesteading.

feeds.title: The Unlikely Homeschool
feeds.description: The Unlikely Homeschool is an online, faith-based site full of ideas, organizational tools, and printables for the busy homeschooling mom.

feeds.title: CHAP
feeds.description: CHAP is an acronym for Christian Homeschool Association of Pennsylvania, a nonprofit corporation founded to encourage and support families interested in home education. We assist parents in understanding & fulfilling the law's requirements and provide leadership & direction on issues facing Christian homeschoolers on a national & statewide basis.

feeds.title: Tree Valley Academy
feeds.description: Tree Valley Academy provides secular educational resources and free printables for homeschooling parents of elementary aged children. Spelling, word puzzles, math and French are the most frequent topics. The goal is always to make learning fun!

feeds.title: Not Consumed » Homeschooling
feeds.description: Not Consumed share resources, guides, and tips for Homeschooling here! Hi, I'm Kim Sorgius and my number one desire is to help kids and families grow in faith so we will never feel consumed by life's struggles. My passion for helping families grow in faith is deep-rooted in a pretty messy life story, mercifully redeemed by our incredible God!

feeds.title: Sonlight Homeschooling Blog
feeds.description: Sonlight Curriculum is a Christian homeschooling company specializing in literature-based homeschool curriculum programs. We provide complete homeschool curriculum packages and individual homeschool materials for your homeschooling needs. Read and find Homeschooling tips, guides, and more insight in our blog.

feeds.title: Raising Arrows » Homeschooling
feeds.description: In 2005, shortly before my 4th child was born, I started this blog to chronicle my homeschooling and homemaking journey. As my family grew, my blog grew, and now Raising Arrows is considered the go-to resource for homeschooling multiple ages!

feeds.title: Homeschool Preschool
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Tara, owner of Homeschool Preschool. Homeschool Preschool exists to give you the resources you need to homeschool your youngest learners. We believe that learning can and should be fun. Find fun, educational and innovative homeschooling activities for your kids in our blog.

feeds.title: Total Language Plus Blog
feeds.description: Our Christian homeschool blog delivers tips and tricks for homeschooling your children. Learn how to design curriculum, lesson planning, and other valuable insights for parents. Total Language Plus offers discovery-style, Charlotte Mason-inspired learning with a literature-based homeschool curriculum designed for Christian education.

feeds.title: My Joy-Filled Life » Homeschool
feeds.description: At My Joy-Filled Life, you will find homeschooling advice, large family management tips, recipes, pregnancy and parenting wisdom, homeschool curriculum reviews, free printables, and more.

feeds.title: Abeka Homeschool Blog
feeds.description: Abeka Homeschool blog, a place where homeschooling families discover inspiration, recipes, craft ideas, and support. Abeka mission is to support and equip students, teachers, and parents by providing amazing Pre-K through Grade 12 academic resources based upon biblical values.

feeds.title: Janelle Knutson Blog
feeds.description: Janelle Knutson in her blog uses Biblical truth to inform everyday lives of homeschool moms. Here you will discover Curriculum suggestions, Parental guides, Encouragement for Bible reading among other Christian-focused reading material. Janelle is a homeschool blogger, YouTuber, podcaster, consultant, and speaker

feeds.title: Teaching Mama
feeds.description: Teaching Mama is a education blog, dedicated to sharing hands-on learning activities for children, particularly toddlers and preschoolers. Angela shares sensory play ideas, ways to keep toddlers busy, preschool learning activities, pintables, and thoughts on motherhood.

feeds.title: Homeschool Iowa Blog
feeds.description: Find all of the latest detailed information about a wide range of homeschooling topics and upcoming Homeschool Iowa events on our blog. Homeschool Iowa is a non-profit that exists to equip and encourage Iowa homeschooling families and to promote and protect home education in our state.

feeds.title: Apologia Blog
feeds.description: Check out our blog to learn more about homeschooling and how Apologia can help with your homeschooling journey. Developed by leading scholars, Apologia provides creation-based, K-12 homeschool curriculum that equips and empowers you to help your students reach their academic goals and nurture their love of God.

feeds.title: Christian Homeschool Moms Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Demetria, a homeschool mompreneur, and songwriter. Read the Christian Homeschool Moms Blog to learn more about homeschooling and stay motivated on your journey. This blog is not only a collection of homeschool helps and resources but also chronicles my life as a homeschool mom for over 15 years.

feeds.title: Confessions of a Homeschooler
feeds.description: Hi, I am Erica Arndt a Christian Homeschool mom with a wonderful husband and 4 precious kiddos! Confessions of a Homeschooler is a blog full of homeschooling ideas, resources, and printables. It quickly morphed into a place for sharing ideas and resources with other homeschoolers! And now we've even added in our cooking, quilting, and crafting adventures too!

feeds.title: Seton Magazine
feeds.description: Seton Magazine was launched as an online magazine in 2013 and has continued to publish daily inspiration, ideas, and experiences for the Catholic homeschooling community. We're excited to be sharing with you an increasing number of new contributing voices on top of our veterans.

feeds.title: Raising Lifelong Learners Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Colleen, gifted specialist, educational consultant, author, speaker, and homeschool mom of four gifted/twice-exceptional kids. I help families like yours trust themselves to embrace the adventure of a delight-directed approach to education with lessons, challenges, tips, classes, and a community of like-minded kids and their parents.

feeds.title: My Little Robins Blog
feeds.description: I'm Leah, a former teacher, and current stay-at-home mom. I realized that there was very little information about using Charlotte Mason in the early years. Hence this blog. I want to share with you different topics and perspectives.

feeds.title: Weird, Unsocialized Homeschoolers
feeds.description: Hey there! We are Wendy Hilton and Trish Corlew, the owners of Weird, Unsocialized Homeschoolers. Our goal is to be real and to write about the good, the bad, and the ugly of homeschooling. We both love homeschooling our kids, and really, we wouldn't trade our lives for anything, but it's not all rainbows and unicorns, and we won't try to convince you otherwise.

feeds.title: 1+1+1=1 Blog
feeds.description: 1+1+1=1 is owned and written by me, Carisa Hinson. If you are a parent, a homeschooler, a classroom teacher, or anyone who works with children - you are in the right place! At 1Plus1Plus1Equals1, Carisa Hinson offers printables to use in the classroom.

feeds.title: United Christian Homeschoolers Unlimited Blog
feeds.description: United Community of Homeschoolers Unlimited is a large family of homeschoolers growing together, seeking to nurture, train and raise our children well while we home educate them.

feeds.title: Nikki's Thoughts On
feeds.description: I write about daily life, homeschooling, curriculum choices, or whatever I feel people would like to read in order to help other homeschoolers and share little tidbits about myself and family. I do this because I enjoy connecting with other homeschoolers and like-minded people.

feeds.title: Homeschool Connections
feeds.description: Homeschool Connections is committed to making available the best Catholic speakers and instructors to parents and students. It has been providing homeschoolers with live and recorded classes, seminars, and support.

feeds.title: Grace Christian Homeschool
feeds.description: Melissa is a wife to the love of her life and mom to 3 children. She shares her homeschooling and life adventures on her blog.

feeds.title: Homegrown Hearts and Minds
feeds.description: Hi there! My name is Missi. I'm the mom to three amazing, wild little boys, and wife to the sweetest man on earth. I'm an extroverted introvert, enjoy coffee, comfy clothes, reading historical fiction, and any good documentary I can get my hands on. As a homeschooling mom of three, I know all too well the challenges of finding affordable, ready to go early learning printables. If you are planning the homeschool year for your younger children, seeking extra practice, or simply looking for activities to keep them busy, Homegrown Hearts and Minds has many products to choose from.

feeds.title: Intentional Homeschooling
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Chantel, wife, mother, jill-of-all-trades, and founder of this site. I'm a teacher-turned-homeschooling mother. I started researching all things homeschooling about four years before we even started homeschooling and this site was born out of my desire to give back some of what I've learned and share the journey along the way.

feeds.title: The Fervent Mama » Homeschool
feeds.description: Discover Homeschooling tips, Fun activity suggestions, Study tools, and brilliant Bible insight for your kids at the Fervent Mama. The Fervent Mama by Brooke Poston is a hub for Christian Moms to learn, share and discuss how to raise their kids according to the bible. Brooke is a lifestyle blogger and Christ-follower.

feeds.title: Inspire the Mom » Homeschool
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog! I'm Jessica and I'm so glad you're here. I'm a teacher turned stay-at-home, mom of three. I spend my days homeschooling my kids and doing my best to give them a well-rounded, and joyful education. During nap/quiet time I blog my heart out, sharing thrifty resources and ideas that I have found useful on my journey of motherhood, particularly in the area of homeschooling and education.

feeds.title: C.O.A.C.H. Homeschool Blog
feeds.description: C.O.A.C.H. will be an innovative, responsive organization that thinks large and lives locally. We will lead in advancing Christian education, community, and cultural enrichment locally and globally. We aspire to be a vibrant, Christ-centered place of excellence for learning and culture - preparing students for leadership and success in a complex and changing world.

feeds.title: Christiana Homeschool Blog
feeds.description: Christiana Homeschool Academy is a classical, Christ-centered classroom program for homeschoolers. It provides the 'best of both worlds' of homeschooling and private school education. Checkout our blog at CHA. We cover a range of topics and issues to help homeschooling students and families.

feeds.title: HOMESCHOOL CHRISTIAN MOM
feeds.description: I am Elizabeth Estelle, Homeschooled Christian Mom, providing homeschooling support for moms who have an 'I'm stuck' moment during the day. I have resources you can use to make your homeschooling more efficient as you get into a good rhythm of learning. I discuss character traits and behavior training tips so that you can see your child grow more like Christ in your homeschool.

feeds.title: A Virtuous Woman » Homeschooling
feeds.description: A Virtuous Woman is a Proverbs 31 Ministry dedicated to helping women let go of perfection and live with purpose. Becoming a Proverbs 31 Woman is possible today through grace-filled, purposeful living. Read about homeschooling tips, tricks, guides, and new ideas in the following section.

feeds.title: Christian Homeschool Hq Blog
feeds.description: My name is Nikki Thomas, I am a wife, a mother, and a certified teacher. I have been married to Jonathan Thomas for 14 years. I started this website for homeschooling parents that desire structure. I have developed my own daily schedule which included spiritual and academic lessons.

feeds.title: Hall of Fame Moms » Homeschooling
feeds.description: My name is Tracy and I've been writing from my own little corner of the globe right here at Hall of Fame Moms for over 10 years now. My husband Joel and I have been married for 17+ years and we have two sons whom we've been homeschooling for going on ten years.

feeds.title: How Do I Homeschool Blog
feeds.description: Discover the best homeschool curriculum, educational methods and tips about home education at How Do I Homeschool, A Christian homeschooling blog specializing in Christ-centered Classical and Charlotte Mason home education articles about starting homeschooling.

feeds.title: Homeschool Your Boys » Homeschooling Blog
feeds.description: Homeschool Your Boys is a blog by Michelle who is based in the United States, has been a home school mum for 13 years to her two sons. She writes regularly on her blog to encourage other homeschooling families in their roles as parents and teachers as well as to share tips to help parents inspire and enjoy with their kids.

feeds.title: Teach Them Diligently » Academics
feeds.description: Teach Them Diligently is the leader in homeschool conventions, training, and more. Read articles covering topics related to academics in the following segment of the blog. Teach Them Diligently was born out of a recognized need for more events that celebrate Gospel-Centered homeschooling. It is our mission to help families fulfill the Great Commission, by providing them with opportunities to unite around the Gospel, and with resources that encourage, equip, and inspire them to bring up and educate their children as ambassadors for Christ.

feeds.title: AOP Christian Homeschooling
feeds.description: Alpha Omega Publications helps you discover homeschooling success with a time-tested homeschool curriculum. Its mission is to educate, inspire, and change lives by offering a Christ-centered homeschool curriculum that promotes quality academics along with a Christian worldview.

feeds.title: Geez, Gwen!
feeds.description: Gwen is a Christian homeschool Mom, blogger, and amateur photographer. Geez Gwen! is a lifestyle blog covering family life, homeschool, faith, cooking, art, writing, and photography. Gwen shares a little bit of everything!

feeds.title: My Homeschool Blog
feeds.description: My Homeschool makes homeschooling easier. We are Christian home educators who have resources and programs inspired by Charlotte Mason. In our blog, we share educational content such as curriculum ideas, printables, activity sheets, history facts, tips for parents, and many more interesting homeschooling insights.

feeds.title: Homeschoolin Mama Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Meg. Read our blog as we share tips and encouragement along this homeschool journey of ours. Homeschooling for me is not just about teaching my kiddos math, science, reading, etc. It's about leading my kiddos to Christ and giving them that Christ Centered foundation they will need in life and that is a 24/7 kind of job.

feeds.title: Revival Christian Academy Blog
feeds.description: Revival Christian Academy is a Private School Satellite Program (PSP) comprised of families who individually homeschool their children and we simply assist our families in the process. Our blog provides guidance, support, and accountability to those parents who have chosen to privately homeschool their children to the glory of God.

feeds.title: Christian Home Educators Association of California, Inc. Blog
feeds.description: Thoughts and insights on Home Education from experienced educators and writers. The Christian Home Educators Association (CHEA) of California is a non-profit ministry established in 1982 to provide information, support, and training to the home education community throughout the state.
